bio_en: Anton Poyajian, known as Anton Kosh and as Droshak's 'Tiar Anton', was born in Khotorjur in December 1849 and moved to Karin (Erzurum) at the age of three, where he was educated. At twenty he went to Constantinople and joined the revolutionary ranks, then moved to Bulgaria, where he worked as a printer and was active in local ARF life. He worked under Kristapor on the Yildiz assassination attempt of 1905, and his name came up often at the trial. Thereafter his life was bound to the Droshak house in Geneva, where he died on 14 January 1927.
